strings.同一批城市、同样的迭代次数、同一个随机种子，交给全部 {n} 个算法各跑一遍，曲: The same cities, the same number of iterations and the same random seed are given to all {n} algorithms; the overlaid curves show convergence speed and the table shows the final results.
strings.调高会更准也更慢：要跑全部 {n} 个算法，高迭代 + 多城市可能等上几分钟: Higher values are more accurate but slower: running all {n} algorithms with many iterations and many cities can take a few minutes
strings.跑完自动生成排名表: A ranking table is generated when the run finishes
strings.对比页只画城市，不画各算法的最终路径（叠成一团看不清）。: This page only draws the cities, not each algorithm's final tour (stacked together they would be unreadable).
strings.横轴=迭代代数，纵轴=路径长度。虚线为最近邻基线，其余每条线一个算法。: x-axis = generation, y-axis = tour length. The dashed line is the nearest-neighbour baseline; every other line is one algorithm.
strings.先看「相对基线优化」：这是相对最近邻解的改进幅度，比看绝对长度更有意义。: Look at “improvement over baseline” first: it is the improvement relative to the nearest-neighbour solution, which is more meaningful than the absolute length.
strings.再看收敛速度而不是只看终值：论文里常见「算法 A 最终略好但收敛慢一倍」，这时候: Then look at convergence speed, not just the final value: papers often report “algorithm A ends slightly better but converges twice as slowly”, and then A is not necessarily more useful.
strings.别把小差距当结论：这些都是随机算法，3% 以内的差距换个种子就可能反转。要下结论: Do not read small gaps as conclusions: these are stochastic algorithms, and a gap under 3% can flip with another seed. To conclude anything, run several times and average.
strings.本地命令行跑 python bench.py --sizes 30,60,100: Run python bench.py --sizes 30,60,100 --iters 200 on the command line and paste the results into an article or paper. Adding --pure switches off all local search, to test “the algorithm itself” rather than the local search doing the work.
strings.问题轴共 {n} 个抽象类型：{n} 个建了独立内容页，{n} 个以词条登记（定: The problem axis has {n} abstract types: {n} have their own content page and {n} are registered as entries only (definitions link to the matching anchor on the reductions page); there are also {n} knapsack variant pages, {n} class-level hubs (TSP / assignment / QUBO) and {n} online demo domains. To find a specific problem use the “Problems ▾” menu at the top.
